cascadeInspection: Independent review compared the authenticated complete Relume anatomy with the final DOM, CSS cascade, interactive lifecycle, and all eight cache-busted render states. One full-viewport ren-cover hero owns one local decorative cover image, a two-layer semantic scrim, one vertically centered constrained left copy stack, one visible labelled email input, one submit control, and one legal terms destination. The pristine error and empty status are hidden before custom-element upgrade and with JavaScript disabled; invalid JavaScript submission focuses and exposes the field error, valid enhanced submission clears the field and announces success, and valid no-JavaScript submission follows the real form action. The terms link remains independently usable. Desktop light/dark, 768, 767, 390, 320, reduced-motion focus, and JavaScript-disabled captures preserve the intended hierarchy, responsive column-to-row form transition, legible overlay contrast, 44px targets, clean wrapping, and viewport coverage. No extra CTA, navigation, logo, chevron, duplicate affordance, clipping, overflow, framework code, raw flex/grid skeleton, or forbidden chromatic literal remains.
